Name: Pulneys - Dark Roast - Cacao Nibs
Tasting_Notes: Cacao Nibs • Brown Sugar •Dark Chocolate • Full Bodied • Lingering aftertaste
Desc:
Grey | Pulneys - 100% Organic Coffee   
 
  
 
 Indulge in the rich, chocolatey flavour of Mr. H.R. Iyer’s Organic Dark Roast, a coffee that stands out for its depth and complexity. This artisanal coffee, grown with care on an  organic farm , offers a harmonious blend of bittersweet notes—think  Cacao Nibs, Brown Sugar, caramel and Dark Chocolate—that come together in a velvety, syrup-like body.  
 Perfectly balanced, this dark roast pairs beautifully with milk and/or sugar, making it an excellent choice for a variety of preparations. Whether you’re crafting a comforting Vietnamese coffee with condensed milk or a comforting mocha, this coffee elevates every sip. Brew it in a Moka pot, French press, espresso machine, or a South Indian filter to unlock its rich aroma and flavour. 
 Crafted by the skilled hands of Mr. H.R. Iyer, this coffee is more than just a drink; it’s a moment of indulgence. Treat yourself to the warmth and depth of a truly exceptional coffee experience, and let each cup be a reminder of the craftsmanship and passion behind it. 
  100% Arabica

Name: The Lumen Blend - Light Roast
Desc:
Lumen Blend – Light, Bright & Fruity Coffee  
 The  Lumen Blend  is made with  100% Arabica  coffee, combining three amazing coffees from different regions of India. This special blend brings out the best flavors from each origin, creating a smooth and flavorful cup. 
  Light-Medium Roast  Roasted to a  light-medium level , this coffee has the perfect balance of  sweetness and acidity , making it easy to enjoy. 
   Flavor Profile  Expect a lively,  fruity  cup with notes of  orange and berries , complemented by a  medium body . The result is a refreshingly complex coffee with a smooth, lingering finish. 
  Perfect for Manual Brew Method  Whether you enjoy  pour-over, AeroPress or French press , the Lumen Blend adapts effortlessly, offering a consistently delicious experience. 
 Discover a coffee that shines with every sip – the  Lumen Blend , a tribute to India’s finest specialty coffees. 
  100% Arabica  
  *No added sugar, honey, fruit, flavour, chicory, or preservatives.

Name: The Saigon Blend
Desc:
The Saigon Blend 
  It's a Good Morning, Vietnam  
 Inspired by the rich culture, traditions, and flavours of Vietnam, The Saigon Blend is a tribute to the vibrant coffee heritage of this Southeast Asian gem. Crafted from premium Indian Arabica beans, this dark roast is meticulously balanced to offer a harmonious experience of bitterness, sweetness, and acidity. 
  Flavour Profile:  
 
 
 Toasted Nuts:  Warm, inviting, and reminiscent of traditional Vietnamese coffee. 
 
 Cacao:  A deep, rich chocolatey undertone that adds a velvety smoothness to every sip. 
 
  Roast Level:  Dark 
  Perfect For:  Iced manual brew, Vietnamese-style coffee, a hot cappuccino, or an iced black coffee 
  Tasting Notes:  
 
 Despite its dark roast, the flavours remain well-balanced, never overpowering, ensuring an enjoyable cup every time. 
 The nuanced bitterness is complemented by a subtle sweetness, making it versatile for various brewing methods. 
 The complex acidity rounds out the flavour, providing a full-bodied experience that lingers pleasantly on the palate. 
 
 Whether you're craving the boldness of a hot cappuccino or the refreshing chill of an iced brew, The Saigon Blend offers a taste of Vietnam in every cup. Embrace the morning with the rich, satisfying flavours of The Saigon Blend—because every day should start with a touch of Vietnam.

Desc:
The Swell Blend  
  Discover the Perfect Harmony in Every Sip  
 Introducing The Swell Blend, our first-ever coffee blend, crafted with precision and passion. This blend combines 100% Arabica beans sourced exclusively from the renowned coffee region of Chikmagalur. 
  Flavour Profile:  
 
 
 Chocolatey:  Rich and indulgent, providing a comforting and familiar base. 
 
 Nutty:  Subtle undertones of nuts add depth and complexity. 
 
 Fruity:  Hints of fruit bring a delightful brightness to the cup. 
 
  Roast Level:  Medium 
  Perfect For:  Filter coffee and all manual brewing methods 
  Tasting Notes:  
 
 Balanced and smooth, with a mild acidity that enhances the flavour without overpowering. 
 Low bitterness ensures a pleasant and enjoyable drinking experience. 
 Great sweetness that lingers on the palate, making each sip a delightful treat. 
 
 Whether you're starting your day or enjoying a quiet moment, The Swell Blend promises a memorable coffee experience, celebrating the rich heritage of Chikmagalur coffee. 
 100% Arabica

Name: Watermelon ferment - Perfect for Espresso & Cold Brew
Process: Watermelon Fermented (coffee cherries co-fermented with ripe watermelon pulp)
Desc:
Watermelon Fermented   
  Inspired by innovative fermentation techniques , our Watermelon Fermented Coffee is crafted at the Baarbara Estate using only fresh watermelon pulp to highlight the fruit’s bright, juicy character. This medium-roast, 100% Arabica coffee delivers an exhilarating cup that’s as refreshing as it is complex. 
 Flavour Profile 
 
 
 Chocolate Truffles  → Deep, rich cocoa sweetness 
 
 Almonds & Cashews  → Warm, roasted-nut undertones 
 
 Dry Fruits  → Subtle texture of raisin and fig 
 
 Mellow Sweetness  → Silk-like finish that rounds out the cup 
 
  Origin & Process  
 
 
 Location:  Bababudangiri, Chikmagalur 
 
 Process:  Watermelon Fermented (coffee cherries co-fermented with ripe watermelon pulp) 
 
 Altitude:  3,850–5,350 ft 
 
  Roast & Brew  
 
 
 Roast Level:  Medium + roast 
 
 Perfect For:  Espresso, Cold Brew, French Press or Moka Pot  
 
  Allow your beans to  degas for 8–10 days  after roasting to develop and settle the nuanced chocolate-nut flavours. Over time, the cup will reveal layers of truffle-like richness, roasted-nut warmth and a gentle, lingering sweetness. 
   
  
  *No added sugar, honey, fruit, flavour, chicory, or preservatives.  
     Tulum® – Specialty Coffee Roasters
